description: Normalized access evidence for one system, such as GitHub, AWS, or ClickHouse. It covers sign-in rules, members, admins, root accounts, machine credentials, and connected apps. MFA here covers only people who sign in without SSO. The identity provider's MFA for SSO sign-ins is in idp-posture. When a system has several accounts or subscriptions, the sections hold totals across all of them, and scopes lists each one at the audit level. A *_present flag is then true when it is true in any scope. Each sign_in value is then false when it is false in any scope, null when it is null in any other, and true otherwise. Every metric is optional. Below the audit level, counts are left out, and the *_present flags are written instead

members.description: People with an account in the system, or with a role anywhere in it, such as on one project, resource group or resource. Service users, service accounts and accounts that can only call the API, such as a cloud user with access keys and no console password, count as credentials. Database users inside a service are not members.

members_present.description: Whether the system has any members. When false, the member percentages have no members to count

member_count.description: Members, as this section defines them. The member percentages count these.

external_members_present.description: Whether any members come from outside the organization, such as outside collaborators or guests
external_members_present.x-epack-summary: Whether any members come from outside the organization, such as outside collaborators or guests.

external_member_count.x-epack-summary: Members from outside the organization, such as outside collaborators or guests.

sso_member_count.description: Members whose account is linked to SSO
sso_member_count.x-epack-summary: Members who sign in through SSO.

sso_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of members whose account is linked to SSO. Null when there are no members
sso_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of members who sign in through SSO.

local_members_present.description: Whether any members can sign in without SSO, with a password or a social login. A member linked to SSO counts too when the system still lets them sign in another way, so local and SSO members can overlap. When false, local_mfa_coverage_pct has no members to count
local_members_present.x-epack-summary: Whether any members can sign in without SSO, such as with a password or a social login.

local_member_count.description: Members who can sign in without SSO. A member linked to SSO counts when the system still lets them sign in another way
local_member_count.x-epack-summary: Members who can sign in without SSO, such as with a password or a social login.

local_mfa_member_count.description: Members counted in local_member_count who have MFA
local_mfa_member_count.x-epack-summary: Members who can sign in without SSO and have MFA.

local_mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of members who can sign in without SSO and have MFA. Null when no member can sign in without SSO
local_mfa_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of members able to sign in without SSO who have MFA.

inactive_member_count.description: Members with no sign-in or other recorded activity in the last 90 days
inactive_member_count.x-epack-summary: Members with no sign-in or other recorded activity in the last 90 days.

inactive_pct.description: Percentage of members with no sign-in or other recorded activity in the last 90 days. Null when there are no members
inactive_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of members with no sign-in or other recorded activity in the last 90 days.

admins.description: Members who can change who has access to the system, or change or delete any resource in it. This includes members whose default permission gives them that power, such as every member of an organization whose base permission is admin, or every member of a workspace with no restricted environment. Roles that only manage billing, or only manage security features without changing access, are not admins.

admins_present.description: Whether the system has any admins

admin_count.description: Admins, as this section defines them. admin_share_pct divides these by member_count.
admin_count.x-epack-summary: Members who can change who has access, or change or delete any resource.

admin_share_pct.description: Admins as a percentage of members. Null when there are no members
admin_share_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of members who are admins.

local_admins_present.description: Whether any admins can sign in without SSO. An admin linked to SSO counts too when the system still lets them sign in another way. When false, local_admin_mfa_coverage_pct has no admins to count
local_admins_present.x-epack-summary: Whether any admins can sign in without SSO.

local_admin_mfa_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of admins able to sign in without SSO who have MFA.
